{{Quote|Jedi. Ahsoka is Jedi.|Gantika|<ref name="Life and Death" />}}
'''Gantika''' was a [[Togruta]] [[Gender|female]] who served as the elder of a [[Ahsoka Tano's village|village]] on the [[planet]] [[Shili]] during the [[Republic Era]]. When [[Pav-ti Tano]] and [[Nak-il Tano]]'s daughter [[Ahsoka Tano]] was [[Reproduction|born]], Gantika was summoned to the scene in order to be informed of the child's name. A [[Standard year|year]] later, when Pav-ti took Tano on a [[hunting]] rite of passage, Gantika marked the [[Parent|mother]] and daughter's brows with blue paint as a sign of good luck. Tano was abducted by a [[raxshir]] during the hunting trip, and when she miraculously returned to the village riding the [[Species|creature]], which left voluntarily, Gantika identified her as a [[Force-sensitive]].<ref name="Life and Death" />
